thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning a rolling maintenance for us-east1 elastic-burst GPU cohort on Wed 03:30-06:30 UTC. Scope: NIC driver micro-patch + nvlink sanity checks. Impact: reduced elastic capacity ~35% while cohorts evac.
marta: thanks. can you confirm cohort size and eviction cadence? we need to minimize large-batch queueing.
ajosh: typo: i'm josh (not ajosh). cohort size = 8 nodes, cadence = 20m per cohort including 5m verification. overall ~3 cohorts per hour.
emily: routing plan? will live traffic fallback to reserved/dedicated pools automatically?
alex: yes — smart-router rule enabled to prefer dedicated pools for production routes; on-demand will still accept low-priority jobs but queue deeper. we'll also pre-seed prefix cache 45m before start.
infra-bot: Maintenance ticket created: MAINT-2026-331 — watchers: #incidents, #support, #customer-alerts (https://status.redwood.ai/maint/MAINT-2026-331).
carlos: cost note: pre-seeding and a 45m scale-up adds ~USD 2.1k. alternative is to do smaller cohorts (4 nodes) continuously over 8h to avoid scale-up, but that extends maintenance and increases ops overhead. recommendation: short pre-seed window.
marta: agree short pre-seed. also please add a canary: pin 4% traffic to a canary cohort for 30m after first two cohorts. want to watch tail-latency on long requests.
josh: i'll own the route policy changes and canary rule. will push a rollback play if errors spike.
emily: customer comms: i'll draft a status page blurb + targeted email for paying customers in us-east1. include the dedicated fallback and contact.
alex: runbook snippet (to be added to /playbooks/maintenance/us-east1-elastic-evac.json):
```
# evac-run snippet
redwood-evacuate --node $NODE --mode graceful --timeout 90
wait_for_kv_empty $NODE 300 || notify_ops "kv-still-warming"
run nvlink-probe $NODE || mark_for_hard-reset $NODE
reboot_node $NODE && sleep 40 && post_reboot_healthcheck $NODE
```
marta: add step to clear GPU cgroups after reboot: `gpu-reset --node $NODE --cgroup-clear`. we've seen stale cgroups cause scheduler hangs.
infra-bot: SLA guardrail configured: if prod error-rate > 2% for 10m OR p99 latency rises >3x baseline for 5m, abort rollout immediately and failover traffic to dedicated.
carlos: who is primary rollback?
alex: marta primary rollback, josh secondary. marta: i'm available Wed 02:45-07:00 UTC.
josh: ack. i'll standby 03:00-07:30 UTC.
emily: putting draft comms in #customer-alerts for review; CS will run targeted outreach for customers with pinned dedicated infra.
alex: scheduling a 10m preflight at 03:20 UTC to validate pre-seed and route pins. will open a PagerDuty incident and post updates in this thread. thanks :rocket:
